preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and len(S) >= 2 and all(c.islower() for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a non-empty string of length ≥ 2 containing only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({S[:i] + S[j] + S[i+1:j] + S[i] + S[j+1:] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)) if S[i] != S[j]}) + sum(1 for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)) if S[i] == S[j])
postconditions.description: The result is the count of distinct strings obtainable by performing exactly one swap of two distinct characters in S. If all characters are identical, the result is 0 (no distinct swaps possible). Otherwise, it counts all unique strings formed by swapping any two distinct indices i < j, where i and j are 0-based indices in S.
